    for p in sandbox.get_particles_medium():
        if p.active:
            if p.position.y < 1.92:  # Below the medium zone
                sandbox.apply_force(p, (0, NUDGE_FORCE_MEDIUM))
            elif p.position.y > 2.52:  # Above the medium zone
                sandbox.apply_force(p, (0, -NUDGE_FORCE_MEDIUM))
